ref_text: O TIS THE FIRST TIS FLATTERY IN MY SEEING AND MY GREAT MIND MOST KINGLY DRINKS IT UP MINE EYE WELL KNOWS WHAT WITH HIS GUST IS GREEING AND TO HIS PALATE DOTH PREPARE THE CUP IF IT BE POISON'D TIS THE LESSER SIN THAT MINE EYE LOVES IT AND DOTH FIRST BEGIN
text: Oh, Tis the first. Tis flattery in my scene. And my great mind most kingly drinks it up. Mine I well knows what with his gust is green, and to his pallet-doth prepare the cup. If it be poisoned, Tis the lesser sin. That mine I love it, and-doth first begin.
